definitions.gloss: to issue; to draw (a check or bill)
definitions.explanation: To issue a financial instrument such as a check, bill of exchange, or money order.

definitions.gloss: to shake out; to sprinkle; to scatter
definitions.explanation: To shake something out of a container or distribute by shaking.

⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I drew a money order from the bank.

examples.english: I emptied the contents of my bag onto the desk to search.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to shake/wave) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out). Sense 1 (financial) is the more commonly encountered meaning in formal/business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}す: to issue a check
- ⟦{手形|てがた}→手形：06304_tegata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}す: to draw a bill of exchange
- ⟦{為替|かわせ}→為替：04021_kawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}す: to issue a money order

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}る→振り出しに戻る：18867_furidashinimodoru⟧: to go back to square one — from the board game すごろく, where ⟦{振|ふ}り{出|だ}し→振り出し：15931_furidashi⟧ is the starting point

USAGE:
Not to be confused with ⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧ (to start raining/snowing), which uses a different kanji.
